old_reference.reference_answer: Response context exit calls close. close invokes raw.close when _content_consumed is false and invokes release_conn when available (src/requests/models.py:1028-1039). Consumed content skips raw.close, but close itself does not change _content_consumed or set a closed flag. Repeated close on an unread response can therefore call raw.close repeatedly; safe repeated cleanup depends on the underlying object, not an explicit double-close guard here.
